title: Fill the Enclosed Hole
written_solution: Find zero regions that do not touch the outside border. If such a region is enclosed by a single surrounding color, fill the whole interior with that color.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((seen (make-hash)) (out g))
    (for* ([r (in-range (rows g))] [c (in-range (cols g))])
      (when (and (= (at g r c) 0) (not (hash-has-key? seen (cons r c))))
        (define queue (list (cons r c)))
        (define region (list))
        (define border #f)
        (define neigh (list))
        (hash-set! seen (first queue) #t)
        (let bfs ([fuel 0])
          (unless (empty? queue)
            (let ((cur (first queue)))
              (set! queue (rest queue))
              (set! region (cons (list (car cur) (cdr cur)) region))
              (when (or (= (car cur) 0) (= (cdr cur) 0) (= (car cur) (- (rows g) 1)) (= (cdr cur) (- (cols g) 1)))
                (set! border #t))
              (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
                (let ((nr (+ (car cur) (first d))) (nc (+ (cdr cur) (second d))))
                  (when (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                    (cond [(and (= (at g nr nc) 0) (not (hash-has-key? seen (cons nr nc))))
                           (hash-set! seen (cons nr nc) #t)
                           (set! queue (append queue (list (cons nr nc))))]
                          [(not (= (at g nr nc) 0))
                           (set! neigh (cons (at g nr nc) neigh))])))))
            (bfs (+ fuel 1))))
        (let ((colors (remove-duplicates neigh)))
          (when (and (not border) (= (length colors) 1))
            (set! out (paint-cells out region (first colors)))))))
    out))
